mapper.select: INSERT INTO derive_character_profile ( run_id, character_key, display_name, public_goal, private_need, contradiction, wound, capability, limitation, secret, decision_rule, speech_pattern, behavior_pattern, current_status, arc_state, profile ) VALUES ( #{p.runId}, #{p.characterKey}, #{p.displayName}, #{p.publicGoal}, #{p.privateNeed}, #{p.contradiction}, #{p.wound}, #{p.capability}, #{p.limitation}, #{p.secret}, #{p.decisionRule}, #{p.speechPattern}, #{p.behaviorPattern}, #{p.currentStatus}, #{p.arcState}, #{p.profile}::jsonb ) RETURNING id
